title: Triton Tiled Matrix Transpose
seoDescription: Implement tiled matrix transpose in Triton by swapping load and store strides with masked boundary tiles.
description:
Implement 2D matrix transposition in Triton by swapping tile row and column strides with boundary masking.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
Y_{ji} = X_{ij}
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Map 2D thread block IDs to input and output tile coordinates.
2. Load input tile with row-major memory stride.
3. Store tile to output buffer with swapped column-major stride.
4. Return transposed matrix.

**Returns:** 2D list representing transposed matrix.
